projects.title: AI-Assisted Security Event Detection Platform
projects.description: Built a security event processing platform using Python and Kafka/Kinesis, combining deterministic detection rules, risk scoring, and LLM-assisted alert summaries. Designed for secure log handling, role-based access control, auditability, and observable performance under load.

projects.title: Secure RAG System
projects.description: Developed a secure AI-powered document retrieval system using Python, OpenAI APIs, and sentence-transformers featuring vector search, semantic chunking, role-based access control (RBAC), audit logging, metadata-aware retrieval, and secure context generation for LLM apps.

projects.title: Distributed API Gateway
projects.description: Built a containerized distributed API gateway with TypeScript-Express, Redis, featuring JWT auth, request routing, proxy forwarding, and round-robin load balancing, token bucket rate limiter using Lua for atomic updates across stateless instances, with monitoring and load testing

projects.title: COURSE HUB
projects.description: Subscription based learning platform with payment Integration, users can search, request, purchase, watch videos. Admins can watch stats on dashboard, manage roles, users, courses.

projects.title: DevSecOps
projects.description: Deployed robust application on AWS EC2 using Docker, Jenkins, SonarQube, Trivy FS, Prometheus, Grafana, Owasp dependency check, Kubernetes and ArgoCD for efficient resource management, CI/CD, Code Quality, System Monitoring and Visualization, Application security and High Availability.
